Seqtk
-----

Seqtk is a fast and lightweight tool for processing sequences in the FASTA or
FASTQ format.

Usage Examples
--------------

* Convert FASTQ to FASTA:

        seqtk seq -a in.fq.gz > out.fa

* Convert ILLUMINA 1.3+ FASTQ to FASTA and mask bases with quality lower than 20 to lowercases (the 1st command line) or to `N` (the 2nd):

        seqtk seq -aQ64 -q20 in.fq > out.fa
        seqtk seq -aQ64 -q20 -n N in.fq > out.fa

* Fold long FASTA/Q lines and remove FASTA/Q comments:

        seqtk seq -Cl60 in.fa > out.fa

* Convert multi-line FASTQ to 4-line FASTQ:

        seqtk seq -l0 in.fq > out.fq

* Reverse complement FASTA/Q:

        seqtk seq -r in.fq > out.fq

* Extract sequences with names in file `name.lst`, one sequence name per line:

        seqtk subseq in.fq name.lst > out.fq

* Extract sequences in regions contained in file `reg.bed`:

        seqtk subseq in.fa reg.bed > out.fa

* Mask regions in `reg.bed` to lowercases:

        seqtk seq -M reg.bed in.fa > out.fa

* Subsample 10000 read pairs from two large paired FASTQ files (remember to use the same random seed to keep pairing):

        seqtk sample -s100 read1.fq 10000 > sub1.fq
        seqtk sample -s100 read2.fq 10000 > sub2.fq

* Trim low-quality bases from both ends using the Phred algorithm:

        seqtk trimfq in.fq > out.fq

* Trim 5bp from the left end of each read and 10bp from the right end:

        seqtk trimfq -b 5 -e 10 in.fa > out.fa

* Find telomere (TTAGGG)n repeats:

        seqtk telo seq.fa > telo.bed 2> telo.count

{"command": "cd /tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
import random
random.seed(1)
seq = ''.join(random.choice('ACGTacgtN#') for _ in range(120))
with open('big.fa','w') as f:
    f.write('>s1 this is a comment\n')
    f.write(seq+'\n')
    f.write('>s2\n')
    f.write(seq+'\n')
with open('big.fq','w') as f:
    f.write('@s1 this is a comment\n'+seq+'\n+\n'+'I'*60+'#'+'I'*59+'\n')
    f.write('@s2\n'+seq+'\n+\n'+'I'*60+'#'+'I'*59+'\n')
EOF
head -c 300 big.fa; echo; head -c 300 big.fq"}

import ctypes, sys
libc = ctypes.CDLL("libc.so.6")
bits = open('bits11.txt').read()

def run(gen, n=4096):
    return ''.join('1' if gen() < 0.5 else '0' for _ in range(n))

def xorshift64star(seed):
    s=[seed & ((1<<64)-1)]
    def f():
        x=s[0]
        x^= x>>12; x&=(1<<64)-1
        x^= x<<25; x&=(1<<64)-1
        x^= x>>27
        s[0]=x
        return (x*2685821657736338717)&((1<<64)-1)
    return f

def xorshift64(seed):
    s=[seed&((1<<64)-1)]
    def f():
        x=s[0]; x^=x<<13; x&=(1<<64)-1; x^=x>>7; x^=x<<17; x&=(1<<64)-1; s[0]=x; return x
    return f

def splitmix64(seed):
    s=[seed]
    def f():
        s[0]=(s[0]+0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)&((1<<64)-1)
        z=s[0]
        z=((z ^ (z>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9)&((1<<64)-1)
        z=((z ^ (z>>27))*0x94d049bb133111eb)&((1<<64)-1)
        return z ^ (z>>31)
    return f

def glibc_rand(seed):
    libc.srand(seed)
    return libc.rand

def glibc_random(seed):
    libc.srandom(seed)
    return libc.random

def glibc_drand48(seed):
    libc.srand48(seed)
    return libc.drand48

cands = {}
cands['xorshift64star']=run(xorshift64star(11))
cands['xorshift64']=run(xorshift64(11))
cands['splitmix64']=run(splitmix64(11))
cands['glibc_rand']=run(glibc_rand(11))
cands['glibc_random']=run(glibc_random(11))
cands['glibc_drand48']=run(glibc_drand48(11))
for k,v in cands.items():
    print(k, 'MATCH' if v==bits[:len(v)] else 'no', v[:64])
print('obs   ', bits[:64])
EOF

def xs(x,a,b,c,order=0):

import json, ctypes
s="TTTTTTTTGTTGGGGTGTTTGGGGGTGGTGGTGGTTTTGGGTGTGGTTGTGTGTGTGGTG"
print("len",len(s))
b=[1 if c=='T' else 0 for c in s]
libc=ctypes.CDLL('libc.so.6')
for seed in (11,0,1):
    libc.srand(seed)
    r=[libc.rand() for _ in range(70)]
    for name,f in [('mod2',lambda v:v%2),('ge2^30',lambda v:1 if v>=2**30 else 0),('ge2^31/2',lambda v:1 if v>=2**30 else 0)]:
        bb=[f(v) for v in r[:len(b)]]
        if bb==b: print("libc rand seed",seed,name,"MATCH")
libc.srandom(11)
r=[libc.random() for _ in range(70)]
for name,f in [('mod2',lambda v:v%2),('ge2^30',lambda v:1 if v>=2**30 else 0)]:
    bb=[f(v) for v in r[:len(b)]]
    if bb==b: print("libc random",name,"MATCH")
libc.srand48(11)
libc.drand48.restype=ctypes.c_double
r=[libc.drand48() for _ in range(70)]
for name,f in [('lt.5',lambda v:1 if v>=0.5 else 0)]:
    bb=[f(v) for v in r[:len(b)]]
    if bb==b: print("drand48",name,"MATCH")
print("obs:",''.join(map(str,b[:40])))
print("libc rand mod2:", ''.join(str(libc.rand()%2) for _ in range(40)))
EOF

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
def berlekamp_massey(bits):
    n=len(bits); C=[0]*(n+1); B=[0]*(n+1); L=0; m=-1; b_=1
    for N in range(n):
        d=bits[N]
        for i in range(1,L+1): d^=C[i]&bits[N-i]
        if d==1:
            T=C[:]
            for i in range(0,n-m):
                if N-m+i<n+1: C[N-m+i]^=B[i]
            if L<=N//2: L=N+1-L; m=N; B=T
    return L,C[:L]
L,C=berlekamp_massey(b)
print("linear complexity of het-choice bits:", L)
print("obs:", ''.join(map(str,b)))
EOF"}

actions.command:
cd /tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, random
def comp(seq):
    open('/tmp/t/z.fa','w').write('>x\n'+seq+'\n')
    r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','comp','/tmp/t/z.fa'],capture_output=True,input=b'',cwd='/tmp/t')
    o=r.stdout.decode().split('\n')[0].split('\t')[2:]
    return o
def pred(seq):
    n=0; c11=0
    for i in range(len(seq)-1):
        if seq[i] in 'CcYy' and seq[i+1] in 'GgRr':
            n+=1
            if seq[i] in 'Yy': c11+=1
            if seq[i+1] in 'Rr': c11+=1
    return (str(2*n), str(c11))
random.seed(9)
alpha="ACGTacgtN#KMWRSYVDBH"
bad=0
tests=["cRcR","CRcR","YGYR","cRGY","cRYG","cRR","cRY","YRY","YGcR","cRYG","YGYY","RYYG"]
for s in tests:
    o=comp(s); p=pred(s)
    print("%-8s c8=%s c11=%s pred=(%s,%s) %s"%(s,o[7],o[10],p[0],p[1], "OK" if (o[7],o[10])==p else "MISMATCH"))
for t in range(400):
    L=random.randint(1,16)
    s=''.join(random.choice(alpha) for _ in range(L))
    o=comp(s); p=pred(s)
    if (o[7],o[10])!=p:
        bad+=1
        if bad<8: print("MISMATCH %-16s c8=%s c11=%s pred=(%s,%s)"%(s,o[7],o[10],p[0],p[1]))
print("bad",bad,"of 400")
EOF

import random, subprocess
def comp(seq, opts=[]):
    open('/tmp/t/z.fa','w').write('>x\n'+seq+'\n')
    r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','comp']+opts+['/tmp/t/z.fa'],capture_output=True,input=b'',cwd='/tmp/t')
    return r.stdout.decode().split('\n')[0].split('\t')[2:]
def pred(seq, u=False):
    cnt=lambda ch: 1 if (not u or ch.isupper()) else 0
    cA=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'Aa'); cC=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'Cc')
    cG=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'Gg'); cT=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'Tt')
    het2=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'KkMmRrSsWwYy'); het3=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'VvDdBbHh')
    cN=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch not in 'ACGTacgtKkMmRrSsWwYyVvDdBbHh')
    c8=0; c11=0
    for i in range(len(seq)-1):
        if seq[i] in 'CcYy' and seq[i+1] in 'GgRr':
            c8 += cnt(seq[i])+cnt(seq[i+1])
            c11 += (1 if seq[i] in 'Yy' else 0)*cnt(seq[i]) + (1 if seq[i+1] in 'Rr' else 0)*cnt(seq[i+1])
    c9=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'KkMmWwSs'); c10=sum(cnt(ch) for ch in seq if ch in 'RrYy')
    return [str(cA),str(cC),str(cG),str(cT),str(het2),str(het3),str(cN),str(c8),str(c9),str(c10),str(c11)]
random.seed(23)
alpha="ACGTacgtN#KMWRSYVDBHX.-"
bad=0
for t in range(800):
    L=random.randint(1,30)
    s=''.join(random.choice(alpha) for _ in range(L))
    for u in (False,True):
        o=comp(s,['-u'] if u else [])
        p=pred(s,u)
        if o!=p:
            bad+=1
            if bad<6: print("MISMATCH u=%s %-30s got %s pred %s"%(u,s,o,p))
print("bad",bad,"of 1600")
EOF

import subprocess, math
def run(qstr):
    open('/tmp/t/z.fq','w').write('@x\nACGTACGT\n+\n'+qstr+'\n')

tests=['IIII5555','IIII!!!!','IIII####','IIIIIIII5555!!!!','5555555555555555','IIIIIIIIIIIIIIII']
for q in tests:
    o=run(q)
    qs=[ord(c)-33 for c in q]
    mean=sum(qs)/len(qs)
    mp=sum(10**(-x/10) for x in qs)/len(qs)
    eq=-10*math.log10(mp)
    p10=[max(10**(-x/10),0.5) for x in qs]

    print("%-18s avgQ=%-6s errQ=%-6s | mean=%.2f eq_p=%.2f eq_cap=%.2f"%(q,o[7],o[8],mean,eq,eq2))
EOF"}

cd /tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
mm=json.load(open('m1_64.json'))
M=(1<<53)
def test_mod(N, mult_only=False):
    # solve A from m2 = A*m1 + C, m3 = A*m2 + C
    m1,m2,m3,m4,m5 = mm[0]%N, mm[1]%N, mm[2]%N, mm[3]%N, mm[4]%N
    d1=(m2-m1)%N; d2=(m3-m2)%N
    if mult_only:
        if m1%2==0: return None
        inv=pow(m1,-1,N); A=m2*inv%N
        ok=all((A*mm[i])%N == mm[i+1]%N for i in range(0,10))
        return ('A=%d'%A) if ok else None
    if d1%2==0: return None
    inv=pow(d1,-1,N); A=d2*inv%N
    C=(m2-A*m1)%N
    ok=all((A*mm[i]+C)%N == mm[i+1]%N for i in range(0,10))
    return ('A=%d C=%d'%(A,C)) if ok else None
for N in [1<<53, 1<<52, 1<<51, 1<<48, (1<<53)-1, (1<<61)-1, (1<<31)-1]:
    for mo in (False,True):
        r=test_mod(N,mo)
        if r: print("mod 2^%d-ish %s mult_only=%s -> %s"%(N.bit_length(),hex(N),mo,r))
print("done")
EOF

* `src/seqtk.c` — original C source, reverse-engineered by running `./executable` (no binary analysis used).

  * record starts only on a line beginning with `>` or `@`;
  * non-header lines before any header are discarded;

    the record is dropped **and reading stops** (kseq_read returns error);

   Java Random, taus88-style. **Search for this is the main TODO.**

   `randbase`, `cutN`, `gap`, `listhet`, `hpc`, `telo` (they fall through to the
   "unrecognized command" branch, so `seqtk <cmd>` currently aborts).

   * `subseq` (BED = 0-based start, 1-based end; labels `name:s-e`; `-t` tab
     output; `-l` folding); name-list mode.

     otherwise unchanged, lengths must match else
     `[stk_famask] Unequal sequence length: %d != %d`, name mismatch
     `[stk_famask] Different sequence names: %s != %s`).
   * `fqchk` : header `min_len: %ld; max_len: %ld; avg_len: %.2f; %d distinct quality values`;
     table `POS #bases %A %C %G %T %N avgQ errQ %low %high`;
     `avgQ` = mean phred, `errQ = -10*log10((sum_i min(10^(-q_i/10),0.5) + 1e-6)/n)`
     (the `+1e-6` per row is essential), `-q0` (or `-q <=0`) switches the last
     columns to one `%Q<val>` column per distinct quality, `%.2f`;
     any seq/qual length mismatch aborts the whole run.
   * `split` writes `<prefix>.%05d.fa`, round-robin by record, `-l` folding.
   * `cutN` (`-n` min N tract, `-p` penalty, `-g` gaps only), `gap -l`
     (min tract len, default 50), `listhet` (1-based pos of het2 only),
     `hpc`, `telo` (BED on stdout, counts on stderr; `-P` prints a profile).
   * `hety` het-rate is scaled x50000, het3 sites make the record vanish.
4. Error/usage strings that must be reproduced verbatim are captured in the
   transcript (e.g. `[E::stk_seq] failed to open the input file/stream.`,
   `[main] unrecognized command '%s'. Abort!`, `seq: invalid option -- 'x'`).
CEOF
cd /workspace && git add -A && git commit -q -m "seqtk reimplementation: kseq + seq/size/comp, report" && git log --oneline | head -3"}
